publicVideo.title: How to Create a Nostr Account with Nostr WoT
publicVideo.availability: Public watch page loaded and showed the exact title, official channel, duration and description.
publicVideo.descriptionSummary: Demonstrates creating an identity, saving the 24-word recovery phrase, setting a local password and locking the vault, then points viewers to import, watch-only and Nostr Connect alternatives.

websiteEvidence.directBrowserResult: The production URL returned a generic Site Unavailable edge page during this run and was not treated as live guide, canonical or Open Graph evidence.

practicalProblem: Helps readers choose among Create New, Import Key or Backup, Watch-Only and Nostr Connect without accidentally creating a second identity or confusing a local vault password with recovery material.
